column1: # Single-bond covalent radii in Angstroms, one row per element, from the crystallographic survey of
# Cordero et al., Dalton Trans. 2008, 2832.  A 3d element whose radius is spin-state dependent takes
# the low-spin value.  The survey covers Z 1..96 and this table states no radius past it: an element
# with no row gets no perceived bond and `perceive_bonds` records the shortfall.
# NOT `atomic_radius`, which the core compiles from `core/elements.tsv`.  That column is the
# calculated (SCF) radius of the free atom -- 0.48 A for oxygen against 0.66 A here -- and their sums
# do not reach a peroxide's 1.475 A O-O bond at any multiplier a hydrogen-bonded pair survives.
# Bond perception reads THIS table; a mass, a size or a drawing reads that one.
# `chython/chemistry/test/test_covalent_radii_tsv.py` probes the table with measured bond lengths and
# measured nonbonded contacts, so a wrong digit that changes an answer fails there.
